run_mdr_phonon_benchmark: run a phonon benchmark calculation for an MDR PBE dataset datapoint using a Phonopy object and ASE calculator
get_phonopy_object: create a Phonopy API object from ASE Atoms or pymatgen Structure with specified supercell and displacement parameters
produce_force_constants: run force calculations on displaced supercells and produce force constants using a Phonopy object and ASE calculator
calculate_phonon_frequencies: calculate phonon frequencies in THz at supercell commensurate qpoints or a custom set of qpoints
calculate_thermal_properties: calculate vibrational free energy, entropy, and heat capacity using Fourier interpolation on a qpoint mesh
